election_dates.primarySnippet: N.J.S.A. 19:2-1: Primary elections for delegates and alternates to national conventions of political parties and for the general election shall be held in each year on the Tuesday next after the first Monday in June between the hours of 6:00 A.M. and 8:00 P.M., Standard Time.
election_dates.generalSnippet: N.J.S.A. 19:2-3: General and special elections. The general election shall be held on the Tuesday next after the first Monday in November in each year.

state_background_check.value: No — New Jersey has no blanket felony-disqualification rule for elective office; its only relevant statute permanently bars someone from future office only if they were convicted of an offense that involved or touched the specific state or local office they already held, and by its own text that bar reaches only offices "under this State or any of its administrative or political subdivisions," not federal office
state_background_check.snippet: N.J.S.A. 2C:51-2(d): "In addition to the punishment prescribed for the offense, and the forfeiture set forth in subsection a. of N.J.S.2C:51-2, any person convicted of an offense involving or touching on his public office, position or employment shall be forever disqualified from holding any office or position of honor, trust or profit under this State or any of its administrative or political subdivisions."

enacted_laws.title: A bill to permit States to transfer certain funds from the clean water revolving fund of a State to the drinking water revolving fund of the State in certain circumstances, and for other purposes.
enacted_laws.summary: This bill allows—for one year—a state to transfer amounts from its clean water state revolving fund to its drinking water state revolving fund in order to address a threat to public health as a result of heightened exposure to lead in drinking water. Specifically, a state may transfer no more than 5% of the cumulative amount of the federal grant dollars awarded for its clean water state revolving fund to its drinking water state revolving fund.

enacted_laws.title: Emergency Information Improvement Act of 2015
enacted_laws.summary: (This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The expanded summary of the Senate reported version is repeated here.) Emergency Information Improvement Act of 2015 (Sec. 2) Amends the Robert T. Stafford Disaster Relief and Emergency Assistance Act to include broadcasting facilities within the definition of a "private nonprofit facility" that provides essential services of a governmental nature to the general public, and to include broadcast and telecommunications within the definition of "critical services" provided by such a facility, for purposes of eligibility for certain disaster assistance.

candidates.platform_video_title: We must stand up, protect the right to vote, and fight for the democracy our ancestors dreamed of.

bio_summary.value: Cory is fighting for justice and opportunity for all Americans. That’s why we don't accept a dime from federal lobbyists, corporate PACs, or fossil fuel and pharma execs. This movement to create a more just, loving nation is powered by grassroots supporters like you.

birthplace.snippet: I was born, raised, and have lived in NJ my entire life.

marital_status.snippet: I have been married to my husband, Mike, a Navy veteran and electrician, for 32 years.

employment_record.value: Licensed Property/Casualty (including Health) Insurance Underwriter; owns and operates a small commercial electrical contracting business with her husband
employment_record.snippet: Prior to starting our business, Mike was a Union Electrician, and I was a licensed Property/Casualty (including Health) Insurance Underwriter in our state. I do not have an Ivy League education, I am not a lawyer, and I am not connected to anyone in power. What I am is REPRESENTATIVE. I have faced the same endless struggles you do on a daily basis with everything from affording healthcare and groceries to getting help for a special needs child and trying to save for retirement. I know how we got into this mess and, more importantly, I know how to fix it. We start by cleaning up OUR Congress to end the control of big money and special interests. That can only be done with new leadership, we will not be saved by those who got us here in the first place.

platform.value: Opposes the Citizens United ruling and seeks to clean up how politicians get their money to end congressional corruption and industry control of legislation
platform.snippet: The 2010 SCOTUS ruling on Citizens United opened the flood gates for corruption and put OUR congress up for sale. Since then industry has decided legislation on just about everything. While their profits reach record highs, our pockets have been drained. American lives should be getting better, not harder. Until we clean up how politicians get their money it will only get worse.

platform.value: Wants Americans to be able to own a home, feed their families, educate their children, and go to a doctor if needed
platform.snippet: Most of us want a simple life where we can own a home, feed our families, educate our children, and go to a doctor if needed.

platform.value: Wants to reclaim democracy and return power to the people, with NJ being a leader in this effort
platform.snippet: I want to be in that fight and show that NJ can be a leader in returning power to the people.

bio_summary.value: As an Independent, I answer to YOU and my vote will always represent constituent values, not big donor agendas. Performative pandering gets us nowhere; we must have meaningful policy if we are to have a meaningful quality of life.

employment_record.snippet: Being self-employed, I can identify with middle-class voters.

platform.value: Abolish the IRS and Internal Revenue Code and implement a Flat Income Tax at a rate of 10% or 12%. Abolish the capital gains tax in its entirety, all estate and death taxes, and the AMT.
platform.snippet: Abolish the IRS and Internal Revenue Code and implement a Flat Income Tax. I believe America needs a system of taxation that provides economic security for our middle-class, economic mobility for our working-poor, and reward for business and job creation. As citizens, our relationship with the federal government is defined by our system of taxation. When government takes excessive amounts of what we create, produce, and earn, that relationship is strained. I advocate abolishing the Internal Revenue Code and enacting a Flat-Tax rate of 10% 12%, to promote the economic growth needed in coming decades as we face more potent global economic competition. I believe we should abolish the capital gains tax in its entirety, all estate and death taxes (when you leave this life, the IRS should not follow you), and the AMT.

platform.value: Pro-life; believe life begins at conception with exceptions for the life of the mother and rape/incest. Oppose tax dollars funding abortion. Support parental notification, the ban on partial birth abortion, and pro adoption policies.
platform.snippet: I am pro-life; I believe life begins at conception, and there is inherent value in each individual life. My exceptions are the life of the mother, and the rape/incest exceptions. I believe our government should promote a culture that values innocent human life. I oppose tax dollars funding abortion. I support parental notification, the ban on partial birth abortion, and pro adoption policies.

platform.value: Oppose any attempt by the government that threatens to take away Constitutional right to bear arms. Support Constitutional Carry.
platform.snippet: I will oppose any attempt by the government that threatens to take away our Constitutional right to bear arms and protect ourselves, our families, and our property. I will oppose all attempts to suppress 2A rights whether from domestic or international bodies. I support Constitutional Carry.

platform.value: Prioritize development of domestic energy sources including shale oil. Strongly support the expansion of nuclear power in the U.S.
platform.snippet: Our priority should be development of the almost limitless sources of energy known to be located here in America. America has in shale oil three times the amount of proven oil reserves in Saudi Arabia. Trillions of dollars of assets could be added to our economy. Tens-of-thousands of union blue-collar jobs can be created if America increases domestic energy production. I want to create wealth for our economy, and create these jobs so our middle class has the economic opportunity and security they deserve. We need to safely extract these resources. If development of domestic energy sources cannot be accomplished in an environmentally responsible manner, I will not support development of that project. I strongly support the expansion of nuclear power in the U.S.

platform.value: DOGE should become a permanent federal endeavor. Support a Balanced Budget Amendment to the U.S. Constitution.
platform.snippet: DOGE should become a permanent federal endeavor. I also support a Balanced Budget Amendment to the U.S. Constitution.

bio_summary.value: Being self-employed, I can identify with middle-class voters. I know firsthand financial struggle, debt, and stress. I know the long hours and countless weeks without a paycheck that many small business owners experience as a normal part of their working adult lives. Small business owners will have no better friend in Washington.
